quests.title: Empty a pile of any size
quests.ask: In a two-cell corridor, the far cell holds a pile. Pick up every gem in it and finish on that cell.
quests.nudge: How could the robot tell that the pile is empty?

quests.title: A pile where you start
quests.ask: This time the robot starts on a pile. Collect it and the pile further along, and finish at the far end.
quests.nudge: Does your program look for gems before the robot's first step?

quests.title: A corridor of one cell
quests.ask: A corridor with only one cell, holding a pile. There is nowhere to walk, but the pile still has to go.
quests.nudge: Which parts of your program run when the robot can't take a single step?
